news.title: Gulf Oil Flow at Risk From Lack of Empty Tankers, Tracker Says
news.summary: The number of empty tankers sailing to collect cargoes of Middle East crude is sliding, a trend that could jeopardize the recent revival in the region’s oil flows to global markets, according to Tankertrackers.com, a firm that monitors vessel movements.
